paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of reward modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the gradient norm of a reward model during training. The x-axis, labeled "Training Step", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 7000 with a tick label interval of 1000. The y-axis, labeled "Gradient Norm", also has a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 40 with a tick label interval of 5. A single blue line represents the gradient norm, plotted with a solid line style and no markers. The gradient norm starts at approximately 39 at the first training step, sharply decreases to around 7 by the 250th step, and then fluctuates between 5 and 10 for the remainder of the training steps, with occasional spikes to around 12-15 at steps 2800 and 4200, before stabilizing around 5-7 towards the end of the training at step 7000.
